title: Plugins and Integrations
description: Discover the available plugins and integrations to enhance your experience with Versatile Thermostat. Explore a variety of plugins created by the community to customize and optimize your heating system.
description_short: Extend functionality with integrations, interfaces and blueprints created by the community. If you have developed a plugin, feel free to <0>submit your plugin</0> so it can be shared with the community.
keywords: addons, integrations, plugins, dashboard, Home Assistant, Auto TPI, Versatile Store, TRVZB linearity

integration.step1: Open HACS in Home Assistant (HACS icon in the sidebar).
integration.step2: If the integration is not listed, open the ⋮ menu at the top right, then "Custom repositories", and add the URL https://github.com/{{slug}} with the "Integration" category.
integration.step3: Search for the integration in HACS and click "Download".
integration.step4: Restart Home Assistant, then add the integration via Settings → Devices & services → Add Integration.

interface.step1: Open HACS in Home Assistant (HACS icon in the sidebar).
interface.step2: If the card is not listed, open the ⋮ menu at the top right, then "Custom repositories", and add the URL https://github.com/{{slug}} with the "Plugin" (Lovelace) category.
interface.step3: Search for the card in HACS and click "Download".
interface.step4: Add the card to your dashboard (resources are registered by HACS automatically).

blueprint.step2: In Home Assistant, open Settings → Automations & Scenes → Blueprints.
blueprint.step3: Click "Import blueprint", paste the URL and confirm.

addon.step2: Open the ⋮ menu at the top right, then "Repositories", and add the URL https://github.com/{{slug}}.
addon.step3: Search for the add-on in the store and click "Install".
